task_description: Controlled trace-replay step 1 of 2. Activate exactly one MCP tool group: "laplace_huggingface" (server: Hugging Face). Then call the tool "search-models" on that server with a query targeting Hugging Face models trained on classical art / museum artifact datasets, using the canonical Met Museum doc ID as a semantic hint. Suggested query string: "met object 315023 greek vase attic red-figure amphora classical antiquity museum artifact image dataset". If the tool accepts only a query parameter, pass that single string. Return verbatim the raw tool output: the list of matched model IDs, names, download counts and tags if available. IMPORTANT CONSTRAINTS: Do not call any other MCP tools or groups (do NOT activate laplace_paper_search, Met/museum collection tools, image tools, or anything else). Do not retry more than once. If the tool is unavailable, errors out, or times out, report exactly that outcome (the error message or "skipped due to error/timeout") and invent no results whatsoever.

Controlled trace-replay step 2 of 2. Activate exactly one MCP tool group: "laplace_paper_search" (server: Paper Search). Then call the tool "search_semantic" on that server to find Semantic Scholar papers that cite or use Hugging Face models trained on classical art / Greek vase / museum artifact datasets. IMPORTANT INPUT CONSTRAINT: the preceding step (Hugging Face search-models) FAILED because that MCP group was unavailable, so there are NO identified model names to pass. Therefore query only with the generic descriptive text, e.g. query: "Hugging Face model trained on classical Greek vase Attic red-figure pottery museum artifact dataset for art image interpretation". Do NOT fabricate, guess, or invent any specific model name, model ID, paper ID, DOI, or arXiv ID in the arguments or in the output. Return verbatim the raw tool output if it succeeds: paper titles, authors, year, venue, citation counts and paper IDs. If the tool group or tool is unavailable, errors out, or times out, report exactly that outcome ("skipped due to error/timeout" plus the error message) and stop. Do not retry more than once. Do not activate or call ANY other MCP tool group or tool (no browser tools, no Met/collection tools, no Hugging Face tools).
